next_external_step: Collect Windows ssh -vvv diagnostics for the same server and port using a simple remote echo command; identify and resolve the connection closure, then retry Connect-Windows.ps1 to transfer version evidence and reference DLLs and keep the tunnel open.
completion_rule: Do not mark complete until original-game behavior and declared supported scenario parity have been verified. Simulator-only tests do not prove local game parity.
limitations: Windows report and reference assemblies are still absent.
Bridge source preparation verifies patch hooks only; compilation and reflected Enchantment property still require actual game assemblies and a live run.
Comparison coverage excludes catalog-derived card values and hidden RNG; a matching finite trace never proves global game parity.
Exact original/simulator initial state and RNG alignment still require implementation and live evidence.
Reference replay checks one declared seed and refuses initial-state mismatches; no automatic original-game staging or RNG import is implemented.
